SLAY_THE_STELLA_KEYWORD_DISC.title: Disc
SLAY_THE_STELLA_KEYWORD_DISC.description: When played, gain 1 of each Musical Note shown at the top right of the card.
SLAY_THE_STELLA_KEYWORD_HARMONY.title: Harmony
